title: Compose read-only and write permission packs
narrative: Fangore’s host app must not let agents write the filesystem by default. A read-only pack refuses the write tool; composing it with a write pack allows the same tool. He needs reusable permission packs instead of copy-pasted lists. Grant composition feeds personal-agent MH-PA-02 (`fangore_insp_authority_gate`)[^insp-pa-02-grants].
implementation:
`AccessPolicy` deny-by-default grants; `CompoundPolicy` unions packs; `AccessControl` enforces tool grants and emits access-check events. This is the permission half of tool gating — every tool call must pass access before side effects.

Covers: host compound grants.
